messages:
Asha Patel: Quick sync — final pass on Hosted / Dedicated / Private copy before launch. Focus: launch post cadence, webinar landing + signups, inbound lead routing, and microcopy to cut pre-sales questions. Who picks what?
Miguel Torres: I can run launch posts + social timeline. Hero message should emphasize predictable inference economics over model access.
Samira Chen: Dropped two hero options in the doc. Need punchier subheads. Options: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and cost" OR "One API. Any deployment. Predictable inference."
Jules Park: Updated mock CTAs: "Try Hosted" / "Reserve Dedicated" / "Deploy Private". Shortened CTAs so secondary fits above the fold.
Nina O'Connor: SEO note: prefer "inference API" and "LLM inference platform" over "LLM hosting". Use "deployment options" as H2 and add canonical on /deployments.
Miguel Torres: Proposed timeline: wk1 blog + social, wk2 benchmarks webinar, wk3 case study follow-up. Webinar landing must route signups to Sales vs Growth SDR by intent.
Samira Chen: Landing webhook pseudocode:
```
if email.endsWith("@company.com") && est_monthly_tokens > 10000:
  route = "sales@redwood.com"
else:
  route = "growth-sdr@redwood.com"
// include utm_source and deployment_interest
```
Miguel Torres: Also tag leads with deployment_interest: hosted|dedicated|private. If CTA was "Reserve Dedicated" mark enterprise-interest.
Jules Park: Dedicated card microcopy: "Reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput. SLA-backed uptime and latency targets. Contact sales for capacity pricing." Tooltip: "Predictable performance at scale — ideal for production workloads."
Nina O'Connor: Standard lead schema for CRM mapping: lead_type: webinar|trial|enterprise, deployment_interest: hosted|dedicated|private, lead_source: social|blog|webinar. Put all fields in the webhook payload.
Samira Chen: Post-signup email flow: immediate thank-you (links: quickstart, runbook, calendar), day-before reminder, follow-up with benchmark highlights + CTA to request a dedicated trial. If routed to sales, include SSO link and lead context.
Asha Patel: Final asks by EOD Thu: 1) final hero + 3 CTAs, 2) add webhook pseudoconfig to the dev ticket, 3) draft webinar narrative (benchmarks + migration playbook + live Q&A). Staging copy goes live Fri if PR merged. :rocket:
Miguel Torres: On it :thumbsup:
Samira Chen: I'll open the PR for copy + email templates and tag folks.
deploy-bot: Deploy to staging scheduled Fri 16:00 UTC — will include marketing pages if PR merged.
Asha Patel: Ping if blocked, otherwise we'll ship the draft and iterate from analytics after the webinar.
